changelog:
Initial release of hyperthink: a fully automatic, triple-perspective council style deep research engine.

- Provides an end-to-end research pipeline triggered by /hyperthink, with unattended multi-stage execution and no checkpoints after scope confirmation.
- Orchestrates three agent personas (Optimist, Analyst, Critic) to generate sectioned deep-dives, fact-checks, and a unified synthesis.
- Integrates with the interrogate skill for scope narrowing via adaptive Q&A before launch.
- Outputs include per-section deep-dives, structured audits, a long-form synthesis, and an executive brief (.md and optional .docx).
- Supports notifications via webhook or Telegram, with all outputs stored under /data/hyperthink/.
- Requires Anthropic API and recommends python-docx for docx export. Estimated cost: ~$55–75/run. Typical run time: 8–18 hours.
summary: Triple-perspective deep research engine. Triggered by /hyperthink. Runs an interrogate flow to narrow scope, then executes a 6-stage fully automatic pipeline...
